svg.text: Milestone 1 blueprint — five nodes on one Ethernet Bridge
One blueprint = one car (vehicle A, the ego). R1–R4 label the message flows; R5 deploys the nodes, R6 is the network.
R3 (TrackedObject) is the ego-internal track schema — it reaches the wire only as the object snapshot embedded in every R4 message.
All four role nodes declare exactly one ethernet pin; the three flows are different UDP ports on the same NIC, not separate pins.
R5 — every ECU is one node of one blueprint; deploying the blueprint creates the Room that is the working environment.
The IVI is the only non-container node: the provided AAOS artifact plus the team APK installed over ADB — it runs no OCI image.
